How funny that he forgot to mention his own role in Londongrad...
"Jonathan Pie" started out as an RT show in 2016. It seems he was perfectly happy taking Russian money
to criticize the UK even when the nature of Putin's regime was apparent. He is no longer affiliated, to be
clear. But neither has he expressed regret, to my knowledge.
I'm sure real UK experts like Catherine Belton, Oliver Bullough, anyone at Tl or RUSI, countless others
would've been available to do this... Strange choice by NYT.
